name: PsychonautWiki
author: cens0r3d
description: Psychoactive substance reference from PsychonautWiki: chemical and psychoactive class, routes of administration with dose ranges, the full duration breakdown, bioavailability, tolerance, addiction and toxicity notes, dangerous/unsafe/uncertain interactions and the documented subjective effects. Data comes from the PsychonautWiki GraphQL API and its MediaWiki API, cached in memory and on disk, browsable by name, alias, class and a random pick.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any End User Data.
install_msg: Thanks for installing PsychonautWiki! Use `[p]psychonaut` for the command overview. No configuration and no API key needed: the cog pulls the substance index on first use and keeps a local copy for outages. Harm reduction reference only, not medical advice.
